Initialize a new ZQK project in the current directory.

Supports three initialization scenarios:
  1. Greenfield: Brand new project (default)
  2. Legacy: Existing project being brought under ZQK management
  3. Snapshot: Initialize from snapshot data (test scenarios)

This command creates the necessary directory structure and configuration files
for a new ZQK project. It sets up:
  - .zqk/ directory for configuration and state
  - .zqk/process/ directory structure for object storage
  - Initial configuration files

Flags:
    --advanced
      Initialize with an advanced, ontology-aware interface (Semantic Bridge
      Phase 1)
    --answer-file <string>
      Declarative kernel seed answer file (.yaml or .json) for non-interactive
      swarm spawn
    --discover
      Run the interactive Project Discovery Wizard to capture strategic context,
      stakeholders, and important dates. If --legacy is provided, it will
      instead scan and report existing objects.
    --force
      Overwrite existing files
    --from-snapshot <string>
      Initialize from snapshot file (.csnap or .json)
    --ignore-scheduler-down
      Ignore scheduler down warning/lockdown
    --import-ontology <string>
      Import an external ontology during initialization (requires --advanced)
    --legacy
      Legacy project mode (preserve existing files)
    --merge
      Merge snapshot data with existing (snapshot mode only)
    --project-name <string>
      Project name (defaults to directory name)
    --simple
      Initialize with a simple, guided interface (Semantic Bridge Phase 1)
    --template <string> (default: standard)
      Template to use (standard, minimal)
    --wipe
      Wipe existing data before restoring snapshot (requires --force)
    --with-maintenance-jobs
      After init, ensure retention and audit-aggregation scheduler jobs exist
      (same as running 'zqk system ensure-retention-jobs'). Puts the project in
      optimal maintenance configuration.
    --with-onboarding-roadmap
      After init, create the onboarding roadmap seed scheduler job. Start the
      scheduler to run it once and create the priority plan, workstream, and
      backlog items.

  Greenfield: Initialize in current directory (Note: 'system init' is an alias)
  zqk init
  Declarative Seed: Initialize with answer file
  zqk init --answer-file seed.yaml
  Legacy: Initialize existing project
  zqk init --legacy
  Snapshot: Initialize from snapshot (test scenario)
  ZQK_TEST_ROOT=test-scenarios/my-scenario zqk init --from-snapshot snapshot.csnap --wipe
  Snapshot: Merge with existing data
  zqk init --from-snapshot snapshot.csnap --merge
  Legacy + discover: Initialize and report existing objects
  zqk init --legacy --discover
  Greenfield with maintenance jobs
  zqk init --with-maintenance-jobs
  Greenfield with onboarding curriculum
  zqk init --with-onboarding-roadmap

Usage:
  zqk system init [flags]

Flags:
      --advanced                  Initialize with an advanced, ontology-aware interface (Semantic Bridge Phase 1)
      --answer-file string        Declarative kernel seed answer file (.yaml or .json) for non-interactive swarm spawn
      --columns string            Override column widths for table output (format: field:width)
      --discover                  Run the interactive Project Discovery Wizard to capture strategic context, stakeholders, and important dates. If --legacy is provided, it will instead scan and report existing objects.
      --force                     Overwrite existing files
  -f, --format string             Output format (table, json, jsonl, yaml, csv, json-rpc, stream, agent-prompt, semantic-link, raw, md, html) (default "table")
      --from-snapshot string      Initialize from snapshot file (.csnap or .json)
      --ignore-scheduler-down     Ignore scheduler down warning/lockdown
      --import-ontology string    Import an external ontology during initialization (requires --advanced)
      --legacy                    Legacy project mode (preserve existing files)
      --merge                     Merge snapshot data with existing (snapshot mode only)
  -o, --output string             Write output to file
      --project-name string       Project name (defaults to directory name)
  -q, --quiet                     Suppress non-essential output
      --simple                    Initialize with a simple, guided interface (Semantic Bridge Phase 1)
      --template string           Template to use (standard, minimal) (default "standard")
      --timeout duration          Timeout for command execution (0 = auto-calculate)
  -v, --verbose                   Verbose output
      --wipe                      Wipe existing data before restoring snapshot (requires --force)
      --with-maintenance-jobs     After init, ensure retention and audit-aggregation scheduler jobs exist (same as running 'zqk system ensure-retention-jobs'). Puts the project in optimal maintenance configuration.
      --with-onboarding-roadmap   After init, create the onboarding roadmap seed scheduler job. Start the scheduler to run it once and create the priority plan, workstream, and backlog items.

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
